title: Secretariat employees planned December 4 rally
reason: The report says the planned December 4 rally was postponed after organizers met officials; no gathering on the planned date is documented.
notes: Do not treat the plan as an occurred protest. The earlier November action belongs to the November unit.

title: BDR Welfare Council rally on December 10
reason: Retained report describes a public rally calling for unity against Indian aggression, with no demand on Bangladesh’s own government or state policy documented.
notes: Attendance unreported; exclusion is based on target as reported, not size.

title: BNP-affiliated organizations march towards Agartala land port
reason: Reported grievance concerned attacks on Bangladesh’s mission in India and other Indian actions; no own-state demand or response request documented.
notes: Source estimates around 2,000 vehicles, not attendees. Home-state target remains absent; no threshold inference from vehicles.
